text:
Hi Melissa!
I moved from Switzerland 2 years ago.
Im general life here is much more dynamic, a lot of things going on, people go out during the week, they are very chilled and you will often hear the sentence“Dont worry” 😆Things are open much longer than in Switzerland. 
You can change your profession much easier here I feel like, more opportunities in general.
Work culture in HiTech is demanding but also pretty flexible, I don’t have set work hours, no time clocking, we have a lot of benefits at work and people are coming to the office in Flipflops but hard work is expected. 
I was able to put aside much, much more money in Switzerland. 
The job market is tough here, the war didn’t help. Networking helps with finding jobs.
I have a HF Degree, nobody knows what that is here so I just said it’s similar to a Bachelor’s and nobody asked further questions or checked on it.

Tips: come with savings, be open to new opportunities, make your own friends ( I’m in an amazing group of girls that moved here and it’s been a lifechanger), get a drivers license here if you don’t live in the centre. 
Coming from Switzerland, I love the people here, truly the most amazing and warm people. And the food is incredible too (plus restaurants are cheaper here which is nice) 
PM me if you need help!
